shots.image: Night, behind a chain-link fence in the foreground, the burglar watches through binoculars, a notebook and a big stopwatch in hand; far in the background Gérard walks his patrol with a flashlight.
shots.animate: He lowers the binoculars, clicks the stopwatch and scribbles in the notebook, grinning; Gérard's flashlight beam moves far away. Static camera.

shots.image: Night, Gérard walks along the warehouse fence with a flashlight in one hand and his thermos in the other, bored, warm streetlight glow.
shots.animate: Gérard walks slowly from left to right sweeping the flashlight beam, and yawns. Static camera.

shots.image: Night, Gérard in a small lit guard booth with his feet up on the desk, sipping coffee from his thermos cup, relaxed and happy.
shots.animate: He takes a long sip, sighs with satisfaction and wiggles his feet. Static camera.

shots.image: Night, hidden behind bushes near the fence, the burglar writes in a little notebook, Biscotte the fat orange tabby cat sitting right next to him, both watching the site.
shots.animate: The burglar scribbles notes and nods; the cat turns its head to look at him, bored. Static camera.

shots.image: Night, the burglar tiptoes through the gate in the foreground while in the background Gérard sits in the lit guard booth sipping his coffee, unaware.
shots.animate: The burglar sneaks through the gate on tiptoe while Gérard keeps sipping in the background. Static camera.

shots.image: Day, warehouse yard, Inès holding her tablet, explaining with a raised index finger, confident and friendly.
shots.animate: Inès raises her finger, shakes her head, then taps her tablet. Static camera.

shots.image: Day, Inès shows Gérard a site map on her tablet with several different colored patrol paths, Gérard leans in, attentive.
shots.animate: Inès swipes the tablet, the paths light up one after another; Gérard nods eagerly. Static camera.

shots.image: Night, Gérard in the guard booth proudly looking at his wristwatch with his thermos in hand, Biscotte the fat orange tabby cat on the desk covering his face with a paw.
shots.animate: Gérard checks his watch, smiles and sips; the cat slowly covers its face with its paw. Static camera.
